jobs.name: ExecuTorch weekly shortlist
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm shortlist mode. Read the current Focus part in SKILL.md and collect up to 10 eligible issues within those scopes, reporting shortages without broadening focus, write only issue-dispatch.md and Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/, present to the user and wait for selection. Never start development or write to community repositories.

jobs.name: ExecuTorch daily PR progress
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm PR check mode. Read tracked and authored ExecuTorch PR progress, update only the selected batch Result.md in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/ using exactly the four progress stages, and notify only on meaningful changes, completion, failure or required user action. Stay quiet on unchanged states. Never write to community repositories or trigger development.
